## Interactive H-R Diagram & Evolutionary Track {width="60%"}

::: {.card title="H-R Diagram Simulator" fill="true"}

```{=html}
<style>
  .sim-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; background: #0b0f19; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px; }
  .viz-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; align-items: stretch; }
  #hrCanvas {
    display: block;
    flex: 1.7 1 520px;
    min-width: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    aspect-ratio: 7 / 5;
    background: #090d16;
    border: 1px solid #1e293b;
    border-radius: 10px;
  }
  .controls { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
  .ctl-label { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: #e2e8f0; letter-spacing: .5px; }
  .btn-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; }
  .btn-row button {
    flex: 1 1 200px;
    min-height: 48px;
    padding: 10px 18px;
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #f8fafc;
    background: #1e293b;
    border: 2px solid #475569;
    border-radius: 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
    touch-action: manipulation;
    transition: transform .1s, border-color .15s, background .15s;
  }
  .btn-row button:hover, .btn-row button:focus-visible { border-color: #38bdf8; background: #243447; }
  .btn-row button:active { transform: scale(.97); }
  .btn-row button.active { border-color: #4ade80; background: #14532d; color: #f0fdf4; }
  .btn-row button.mass-high.active { border-color: #60a5fa; background: #1e3a8a; color: #eff6ff; }
  .scrub-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
  .scrub-row button {
    min-height: 48px;
    min-width: 120px;
    padding: 10px 16px;
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #fff7ed;
    background: #7c2d12;
    border: 2px solid #f97316;
    border-radius: 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
    touch-action: manipulation;
  }
  .scrub-row button:active { transform: scale(.97); }
  #stageSlider {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 48px;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    background: transparent;
    cursor: pointer;
    touch-action: none;
  }
  #stageSlider::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 18px; border-radius: 10px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f87171, #fbbf24, #a5b4fc); }
  #stageSlider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: #f8fafc; border: 4px solid #0ea5e9; margin-top: -17px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(14, 165, 233, .25);
  }
  #stageSlider::-moz-range-track { height: 18px; border-radius: 10px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f87171, #fbbf24, #a5b4fc); }
  #stageSlider::-moz-range-thumb { width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 50%; background: #f8fafc; border: 4px solid #0ea5e9; }
  .status-pill {
    flex: 1 1 280px;
    justify-content: center;
    background: #111827;
    border: 2px solid #38bdf8;
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 14px 20px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .sp-stage { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 900; color: #fef3c7; line-height: 1.15; }
  .sp-row { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; font-size: 20px; color: #e2e8f0; line-height: 1.3; }
  .sp-k { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .6px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #94a3b8; }
  .sp-v { font-weight: 700; }
  .sp-v.ok { color: #4ade80; }
  .sp-v.warn { color: #fbbf24; }
  .sp-v.bad { color: #f87171; }
  .card table { font-size: 18px; }
  .card table th { font-size: 18px; }
  .card table td, .card table th { padding: 10px 12px; vertical-align: top; }
  .cer-prompt {
    background: #111827;
    border: 2px dashed #64748b;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    margin: 14px 0;
    min-height: 150px;
    font-size: 18px;
    color: #e2e8f0;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  .cer-prompt b { color: #4ade80; }
  .phenomenon { font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.45; }
  .card-title { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; }
</style>

<div class="sim-panel">
  <div class="viz-row">
    <canvas id="hrCanvas" width="700" height="500" role="img" aria-label="Hertzsprung-Russell diagram with an evolutionary track marker"></canvas>

    <div class="status-pill" id="statusPill" aria-live="polite">
      <div class="sp-stage" id="spStage"></div>
      <div class="sp-row"><span class="sp-k">Core reaction</span><span class="sp-v" id="spReaction"></span></div>
      <div class="sp-row"><span class="sp-k">Equilibrium</span><span class="sp-v" id="spState"></span></div>
      <div class="sp-row"><span class="sp-k">Time in stage</span><span class="sp-v" id="spTime"></span></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="controls">
    <div class="ctl-label">1 · Choose a star mass</div>
    <div class="btn-row" id="massRow">
      <button type="button" class="mass-low active" data-mass="low">Low/Medium Mass (1 M<sub>&#9737;</sub>, Sun-like)</button>
      <button type="button" class="mass-high" data-mass="high">High Mass (10 M<sub>&#9737;</sub>, Rigel/Betelgeuse-like)</button>
    </div>

    <div class="ctl-label">2 · Step through its life</div>
    <div class="btn-row" id="stageRow">
      <button type="button" data-stage="0">Protostar</button>
      <button type="button" data-stage="1">Main Sequence</button>
      <button type="button" data-stage="2">Red Giant / Supergiant</button>
      <button type="button" data-stage="3">Final Remnant (White Dwarf / Neutron / Black Hole)</button>
    </div>

    <div class="scrub-row">
      <button type="button" id="backBtn">◀ Back</button>
      <input type="range" id="stageSlider" min="0" max="300" step="1" value="0" aria-label="Evolution scrubber">
      <button type="button" id="nextBtn">Next ▶</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  var canvas = document.getElementById("hrCanvas");
  var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  var W = 700, H = 500;
  var M = { l: 78, r: 18, t: 16, b: 66 };
  var PW = W - M.l - M.r, PH = H - M.t - M.b;
  var scale = Math.max(2, Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 3));
  canvas.width = W * scale;
  canvas.height = H * scale;
  ctx.setTransform(scale, 0, 0, scale, 0, 0);

  var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

  // Temperature axis is logarithmic and reversed (30,000 K left -> 3,000 K right); luminosity is log10 L from -4 to 6.
  function X(T) { return M.l + PW * (Math.log(30000 / T) / Math.LN10); }
  function Y(lg) { return M.t + PH * (6 - lg) / 10; }

  var MS_CENTER = [[30000, 4.9], [20000, 4.0], [10000, 1.8], [6000, 0.1], [5000, -0.6], [4000, -1.8], [3000, -3.0]];

  var ZONES = [
    { name: "Main Sequence", color: "56,189,248", pts: MS_CENTER.map(function (p) { return [p[0], p[1] + 0.6]; })
        .concat(MS_CENTER.slice().reverse().map(function (p) { return [p[0], p[1] - 0.6]; })), lx: 9000, ly: 2.1, rot: true },
    { name: "Supergiants", color: "251,146,60", pts: [[20000, 6], [3000, 6], [3000, 4.4], [20000, 4.4]], lx: 6200, ly: 5.55 },
    { name: "Red Giants", color: "248,113,113", pts: [[5200, 3.7], [3200, 3.7], [3200, 1.5], [5200, 1.5]], lx: 5400, ly: 2.45, right: true },
    { name: "White Dwarfs", color: "226,232,240", pts: [[30000, -1.5], [6000, -1.5], [6000, -4], [30000, -4]], lx: 14000, ly: -3.45 }
  ];

  var REFS = [
    { name: "Sun", T: 5800, lg: 0, dx: 16, dy: 7 },
    { name: "Spica", T: 25000, lg: 4.3, dx: 6, dy: -10 },
    { name: "Rigel", T: 12000, lg: 5.1, dx: 8, dy: -8 },
    { name: "Betelgeuse", T: 3500, lg: 5.0, dx: 12, dy: 24, right: true },
    { name: "Sirius B", T: 25000, lg: -1.8, dx: 8, dy: 5 }
  ];

  var TRACKS = {
    low: {
      color: "#fbbf24",
      stages: [
        { name: "Protostar", T: 3800, lg: 1.2,
          reaction: "None yet — gas cloud contracts and heats up (no fusion)",
          state: "Gravity compresses the cloud; core not hot enough to fuse", cls: "warn",
          time: "≈ tens of millions of years" },
        { name: "Main Sequence", T: 5800, lg: 0,
          reaction: "H → He (hydrogen fusion in the core)",
          state: "Balanced: fusion pressure outward = gravity inward", cls: "ok",
          time: "≈ 10 billion years (10 Ga)" },
        { name: "Red Giant", T: 3800, lg: 3.0,
          reaction: "H → He in a shell around an inert He core; later He → C/O in the core",
          state: "Core contracts, outer layers expand and cool", cls: "warn",
          time: "≈ 1–2 billion years" },
        { name: "Final Remnant: White Dwarf", T: 16000, lg: -2.3,
          reaction: "None — hot C/O core left after the Planetary Nebula",
          state: "No fusion; electron pressure resists gravity as it cools", cls: "ok",
          time: "Cools slowly for trillions of years" }
      ],
      segs: [
        { pts: [[3800, 1.2], [4300, 0.6], [5200, 0.0], [5800, 0]] },
        { pts: [[5800, 0], [5500, 0.3], [5000, 0.9], [4500, 1.7], [4000, 2.5], [3800, 3.0]] },
        { pts: [[3800, 3.0], [3500, 3.5], [6000, 3.7], [30000, 3.3], [30000, 0.5], [22000, -1.5], [16000, -2.3]] }
      ]
    },
    high: {
      color: "#60a5fa",
      stages: [
        { name: "Protostar", T: 3600, lg: 4.2,
          reaction: "None yet — gas cloud contracts and heats up (no fusion)",
          state: "Gravity compresses the cloud; core not hot enough to fuse", cls: "warn",
          time: "≈ under 1 million years" },
        { name: "Main Sequence", T: 22000, lg: 4.1,
          reaction: "H → He (hydrogen fusion in the core)",
          state: "Balanced: fusion pressure outward = gravity inward", cls: "ok",
          time: "≈ 10–20 million years (Ma)" },
        { name: "Supergiant", T: 3600, lg: 5.1,
          reaction: "He → C/O, then heavier elements, ending with an iron (Fe) core",
          state: "Layered shells fuse; outer layers swell hugely", cls: "warn",
          time: "≈ 1 million years or less" },
        { name: "Final Remnant: Neutron Star / Black Hole", T: 25000, lg: -0.4, offChart: true,
          reaction: "Iron core collapse → Type II supernova explosion",
          state: "Fusion stops; gravity wins and the core collapses", cls: "bad",
          time: "Neutron star or black hole lasts indefinitely" }
      ],
      segs: [
        { pts: [[3600, 4.2], [8000, 4.2], [22000, 4.1]] },
        { pts: [[22000, 4.1], [16000, 4.7], [10000, 5.1], [5000, 5.2], [3600, 5.1]] },
        { pts: [[3600, 5.1], [25000, -0.4]], jump: true }
      ]
    }
  };

  // Precompute screen-space lengths so the marker moves at constant speed along each segment.
  Object.keys(TRACKS).forEach(function (k) {
    TRACKS[k].segs.forEach(function (s) {
      var cum = [0];
      for (var i = 1; i < s.pts.length; i++) {
        var dx = X(s.pts[i][0]) - X(s.pts[i - 1][0]);
        var dy = Y(s.pts[i][1]) - Y(s.pts[i - 1][1]);
        cum.push(cum[i - 1] + Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy));
      }
      s.cum = cum;
      s.len = cum[cum.length - 1];
    });
  });

  var state = { mass: "low", pos: 0, tween: null };

  function pointOnSeg(seg, t) {
    if (seg.jump) { var p = t < 0.5 ? seg.pts[0] : seg.pts[1]; return [p[0], p[1]]; }
    var target = seg.len * t;
    for (var i = 1; i < seg.pts.length; i++) {
      if (target <= seg.cum[i] || i === seg.pts.length - 1) {
        var span = seg.cum[i] - seg.cum[i - 1] || 1;
        var f = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (target - seg.cum[i - 1]) / span));
        var a = seg.pts[i - 1], b = seg.pts[i];
        return [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * f, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * f];
      }
    }
    return seg.pts[seg.pts.length - 1];
  }

  function currentPoint() {
    var track = TRACKS[state.mass];
    var si = Math.min(2, Math.floor(state.pos));
    var t = state.pos - si;
    if (state.pos >= 3) { si = 2; t = 1; }
    return { si: si, t: t, p: pointOnSeg(track.segs[si], t) };
  }

  function lerp(a, b, f) { return a + (b - a) * f; }
  var TEMP_STOPS = [[3000, [255, 107, 61]], [4000, [255, 154, 77]], [5500, [255, 210, 122]], [7000, [255, 244, 214]], [10000, [207, 225, 255]], [30000, [143, 180, 255]]];
  function tempColor(T) {
    T = Math.max(3000, Math.min(30000, T));
    for (var i = 1; i < TEMP_STOPS.length; i++) {
      if (T <= TEMP_STOPS[i][0]) {
        var a = TEMP_STOPS[i - 1], b = TEMP_STOPS[i];
        var f = Math.log(T / a[0]) / Math.log(b[0] / a[0]);
        return [Math.round(lerp(a[1][0], b[1][0], f)), Math.round(lerp(a[1][1], b[1][1], f)), Math.round(lerp(a[1][2], b[1][2], f))];
      }
    }
    return TEMP_STOPS[TEMP_STOPS.length - 1][1];
  }

  function tracePath(pts) {
    pts.forEach(function (p, i) { if (i) ctx.lineTo(X(p[0]), Y(p[1])); else ctx.moveTo(X(p[0]), Y(p[1])); });
  }

  function drawStatic() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#090d16";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Zones
    ZONES.forEach(function (z) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      tracePath(z.pts);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(" + z.color + ",0.13)";
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(" + z.color + ",0.75)";
      ctx.setLineDash([7, 5]);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
    });

    // Grid
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(148,163,184,0.16)";
    for (var g = -4; g <= 6; g++) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(M.l, Y(g)); ctx.lineTo(M.l + PW, Y(g)); ctx.stroke(); }
    [30000, 20000, 10000, 6000, 5000, 4000, 3000].forEach(function (T) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(X(T), M.t); ctx.lineTo(X(T), M.t + PH); ctx.stroke();
    });

    // Axes frame
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#64748b";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeRect(M.l, M.t, PW, PH);

    // Temperature colour bar
    var grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(M.l, 0, M.l + PW, 0);
    grad.addColorStop(0, "#8fb4ff"); grad.addColorStop(0.35, "#fff4d6"); grad.addColorStop(0.65, "#ffb454"); grad.addColorStop(1, "#ff5a3c");
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(M.l, M.t + PH + 3, PW, 7);

    // Tick labels
    ctx.fillStyle = "#e2e8f0";
    ctx.font = "bold 16px sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    [[30000, "30,000"], [20000, "20,000"], [10000, "10,000"], [5000, "5,000"], [4000, "4,000"], [3000, "3,000"]].forEach(function (t) {
      ctx.fillText(t[1], Math.min(Math.max(X(t[0]), M.l + 20), M.l + PW - 18), M.t + PH + 30);
    });
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    var sup = { "-4": "⁻⁴", "-2": "⁻²", "0": "⁰", "2": "²", "4": "⁴", "6": "⁶" };
    [-4, -2, 0, 2, 4, 6].forEach(function (g) { ctx.fillText("10" + sup[String(g)], M.l - 8, Y(g) + 5); });

    // Axis titles
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = "bold 18px sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f8fafc";
    ctx.fillText("Surface Temperature (K)   ← hotter · cooler →", M.l + PW / 2, H - 10);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(18, M.t + PH / 2);
    ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.fillText("Luminosity (Sun = 1)", 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();

    // Zone labels
    ZONES.forEach(function (z) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(X(z.lx), Y(z.ly));
      if (z.rot) ctx.rotate(Math.atan2(Y(1.2) - Y(2.8), X(7500) - X(11000)) * 1);
      ctx.font = "bold 20px sans-serif";
      ctx.textAlign = z.right ? "right" : "center";
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(" + z.color + ",1)";
      ctx.fillText(z.name, 0, 0);
      ctx.restore();
    });

    // Reference stars
    ctx.font = "bold 16px sans-serif";
    REFS.forEach(function (r) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#e2e8f0";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(X(r.T), Y(r.lg), 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.textAlign = r.right ? "right" : "left";
      ctx.fillText(r.name, X(r.T) + r.dx, Y(r.lg) + r.dy);
    });
  }

  function drawTrack(key, emphasis) {
    var track = TRACKS[key];
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.rect(M.l, M.t, PW, PH);
    ctx.clip();
    ctx.globalAlpha = emphasis ? 1 : 0.22;
    ctx.strokeStyle = track.color;
    ctx.lineWidth = emphasis ? 3 : 2;
    ctx.lineJoin = "round";
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 6]);
    track.segs.forEach(function (s) {
      if (s.jump) return;
      ctx.beginPath(); tracePath(s.pts); ctx.stroke();
    });
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    if (emphasis) {
      // Solid trail up to the marker
      var cur = currentPoint();
      ctx.lineWidth = 5;
      for (var i = 0; i <= cur.si; i++) {
        var s = track.segs[i];
        if (s.jump) continue;
        var upto = (i < cur.si) ? 1 : cur.t;
        var pts = [s.pts[0]];
        var target = s.len * upto;
        for (var j = 1; j < s.pts.length; j++) {
          if (s.cum[j] <= target) pts.push(s.pts[j]);
          else { pts.push(pointOnSeg(s, upto)); break; }
        }
        ctx.beginPath(); tracePath(pts); ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // Stage dots with numbers
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = emphasis ? 1 : 0.3;
    track.stages.forEach(function (st, i) {
      var x = X(st.T), y = Y(st.lg);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 11, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#0b0f19"; ctx.fill();
      ctx.lineWidth = 2.5; ctx.strokeStyle = track.color; ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#f8fafc"; ctx.font = "bold 15px sans-serif"; ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillText(String(i + 1), x, y + 5);
    });
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawMarker(time) {
    var cur = currentPoint();
    var track = TRACKS[state.mass];
    var seg = track.segs[cur.si];
    var T = cur.p[0], lg = cur.p[1];
    var x = X(T), y = Y(lg);
    var col = tempColor(T);
    var pulse = reduceMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(time / 260);
    var r = 10 + 3 * pulse;
    var c = col.join(",");

    var supernova = seg.jump ? Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(cur.t - 0.5) * 4) : 0;
    if (state.mass === "high" && state.pos >= 3 && !reduceMotion) supernova = Math.max(supernova, 0.35 + 0.25 * Math.sin(time / 180));

    var glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r * 3.4 + supernova * 40);
    glow.addColorStop(0, "rgba(" + c + ",0.85)");
    glow.addColorStop(0.35, "rgba(" + c + ",0.35)");
    glow.addColorStop(1, "rgba(" + c + ",0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r * 3.4 + supernova * 40, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    if (supernova > 0) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + Math.min(1, supernova + 0.2) + ")";
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 18 + supernova * 34, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    }

    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgb(" + c + ")"; ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffffff"; ctx.stroke();

    var st = track.stages[Math.round(state.pos)];
    if (st.offChart && state.pos > 2.5) {
      ctx.font = "bold 16px sans-serif";
      ctx.textAlign = "left";
      ctx.fillStyle = "#f8fafc";
      ctx.fillText("◀ Off the chart:", x + 24, y - 4);
      ctx.fillText("hotter than 30,000 K", x + 24, y + 15);
    }
  }

  function render(time) {
    drawStatic();
    drawTrack(state.mass === "low" ? "high" : "low", false);
    drawTrack(state.mass, true);
    drawMarker(time || 0);
  }

  // UI
  var els = {
    stage: document.getElementById("spStage"),
    reaction: document.getElementById("spReaction"),
    state: document.getElementById("spState"),
    time: document.getElementById("spTime"),
    slider: document.getElementById("stageSlider"),
    stageBtns: document.querySelectorAll("#stageRow button"),
    massBtns: document.querySelectorAll("#massRow button")
  };
  var lastIdx = -1, lastMass = "";

  function updateStatus() {
    var idx = Math.round(state.pos);
    if (idx === lastIdx && state.mass === lastMass) return;
    lastIdx = idx; lastMass = state.mass;
    var st = TRACKS[state.mass].stages[idx];
    els.stage.textContent = (idx + 1) + " of 4 · " + st.name;
    els.reaction.textContent = st.reaction;
    els.state.textContent = st.state;
    els.state.className = "sp-v " + st.cls;
    els.time.textContent = st.time;
    els.stageBtns.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.toggle("active", Number(b.dataset.stage) === idx); });
    canvas.setAttribute("aria-label", "H-R diagram: " + (state.mass === "low" ? "1 solar mass" : "10 solar mass") + " star at stage " + st.name + ". " + st.reaction);
  }

  function setPos(p, fromSlider) {
    state.pos = Math.max(0, Math.min(3, p));
    if (!fromSlider) els.slider.value = String(Math.round(state.pos * 100));
    updateStatus();
  }

  function cancelTween() { state.tween = null; }

  function goTo(target) {
    target = Math.max(0, Math.min(3, target));
    if (reduceMotion) { setPos(target); return; }
    state.tween = { from: state.pos, to: target, start: performance.now(), dur: Math.min(3000, Math.max(600, Math.abs(target - state.pos) * 1100)) };
  }

  function stepTween(now) {
    var tw = state.tween;
    if (!tw) return;
    var f = Math.min(1, (now - tw.start) / tw.dur);
    var e = f < 0.5 ? 2 * f * f : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * f + 2, 2) / 2;
    setPos(tw.from + (tw.to - tw.from) * e);
    if (f >= 1) state.tween = null;
  }

  function loop(now) {
    stepTween(now);
    render(now);
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  els.massBtns.forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener("click", function () {
      state.mass = b.dataset.mass;
      els.massBtns.forEach(function (o) { o.classList.toggle("active", o === b); });
      cancelTween();
      setPos(0);
    });
  });
  els.stageBtns.forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener("click", function () { goTo(Number(b.dataset.stage)); });
  });
  document.getElementById("nextBtn").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var base = state.tween ? state.tween.to : state.pos;
    goTo(Math.min(3, Math.floor(base + 0.001) + 1));
  });
  document.getElementById("backBtn").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var base = state.tween ? state.tween.to : state.pos;
    goTo(Math.max(0, Math.ceil(base - 0.001) - 1));
  });
  els.slider.addEventListener("input", function () {
    cancelTween();
    setPos(Number(els.slider.value) / 100, true);
  });

  updateStatus();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
```
